Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(2)(a), mezzanines exceeding 185 sq.m in area OR 18.00 m in greatest dimension require at least 2 stairways to the adjacent floor. Large mezzanines behave like partial floors and cannot rely on a single stair as a safe egress route.
